senses.en_definition: Willing or happy to do something.
To like or enjoy something or an activity.
To find something agreeable or suitable; to approve of it.
To feel affection, attraction or love for someone.
To want or welcome something, including an action or event.
To tend to do something or have something happen; to do so frequently or readily.
